paragraph: My research connects \textbf{3D/4D perception, generative world modeling, and memory for embodied intelligence}. My work spans geometry-grounded robot control, autoregressive video generation, and multi-view spatial reasoning. I am now interested in self-improving physical agents through agent--world model co-evolution.

My research connects \textbf{geometric perception, video generation, and multi-view spatial reasoning}. I develop 4D world--action models that make predicted geometry and motion useful for robot control. I am now interested in self-improving physical agents through agent--world model co-evolution.

My research focuses on \textbf{geometry-grounded robot learning and simulation-to-real transfer}. In S4NDBOX, I connect predicted 4D futures to action generation and geometric candidate selection. I am now interested in self-improving physical agents through agent--world model co-evolution.

I study \textbf{world--action models and memory for embodied intelligence}. My work spans multi-view 4D prediction for robot control, autoregressive video generation, and geometry-based spatial reasoning. I am now interested in self-improving physical agents through agent--world model co-evolution.

My research combines \textbf{generative world modeling, video generation, and explicit 3D/4D representations}. I study how predicted appearance, geometry, and motion can jointly inform robot actions and support generalization across visual conditions. I am now interested in self-improving physical agents through agent--world model co-evolution.

I study how \textbf{world models and memory support embodied reasoning and action selection}. My work includes geometry-based multi-view memory and pre-execution consistency checks for world--action predictions. I am now interested in self-improving physical agents through agent--world model co-evolution.

I study \textbf{video prediction and 3D motion representations for robot action}. My work spans 4D world--action modeling and long-video generation with state-space memory. I am now interested in learning from human observations and physical interaction to enable self-improving agents through agent--world model co-evolution.

I study \textbf{autoregressive video generation, hybrid state-space memory, and multimodal world models}. I am now interested in self-improving physical agents through agent--world model co-evolution.

I study \textbf{robust perception and predictive representations for physical AI}. My work spans 4D world--action modeling, geometry estimation in dynamic and extreme-lighting scenes, and high-rate scene understanding. I am now interested in self-improving physical agents through agent--world model co-evolution.

My research focuses on \textbf{world--action models and zero-shot simulation-to-real manipulation}. I study how explicit geometry and motion connect visual predictions to robot actions. I am now interested in extending this work toward humanoid loco-manipulation and self-improving physical agents through agent--world model co-evolution.

I study \textbf{multimodal world modeling and spatial reasoning through structured 3D/4D representations}. My work combines geometry-conditioned action prediction, geometric working memory, and autoregressive video generation.
